mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_api_document_chunks ( document_id, detail_id, chunk_type, chunk_no, chunk_title, chunk_text, source_path, source_url, sort_order, content_hash, chunk_schema_version, chunk_version, activation_status, parent_key, parent_title, parent_source_path, child_order, embedding_text, quality_status, quality_reason, index_status ) VALUES ( #{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.detailId}, #{chunk.chunkType}, #{chunk.chunkNo}, #{chunk.chunkTitle}, #{chunk.chunkText}, #{chunk.sourcePath}, #{chunk.sourceUrl}, #{chunk.sortOrder}, #{chunk.contentHash}, #{chunk.chunkSchemaVersion}, #{chunk.chunkVersion}, #{chunk.activationStatus}, #{chunk.parentKey}, #{chunk.parentTitle}, #{chunk.parentSourcePath}, #{chunk.childOrder}, #{chunk.embeddingText}, #{chunk.qualityStatus}, #{chunk.qualityReason}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(v.expected_chunk_count, 0) AS expectedChunkCount, COUNT(c.chunk_id) AS candidateChunkCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'INDEXED' AND e.content_hash = c.content_hash THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS indexedCurrentCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.quality_status IN ('REVIEW', 'REJECT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blockingQualityCount, v.preview_approved AS previewApproved, v.unexplained_loss_span_count AS unexplainedLossSpanCount, v.preview_token_hash AS previewTokenHash FROM law_api_document_chunk_versions v LEFT JOIN law_api_document_chunks c ON c.document_id = v.document_id AND c.chunk_version = v.chunk_version AND c.activation_status = 'CANDIDATE' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN law_api_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE v.document_id = #{documentId} AND v.chunk_version = #{chunkVersion} AND v.activation_status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'ACTIVATING') GROUP BY v.expected_chunk_count, v.preview_approved, v.unexplained_loss_span_count, v.preview_token_hash

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, doc.effective_status AS effectiveStatus, c.chunk_type AS chunkType, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.target = #{target} AND doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.activation_status = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, doc.title, c.sort_order LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, doc.effective_status AS effectiveStatus, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, NULL AS pageNo, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.content_hash AS contentHash, AS parentSectionTitle, AS sectionType, c.embedding_text AS embeddingText, c.parent_key AS parentKey, c.chunk_version AS chunkVersion FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN law_api_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.activation_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{target} = '' OR doc.target = #{target}) AND ( #{query} = '' OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.agency_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) AND ( e.chunk_id IS NULL OR ( e.status IN ('PENDING', 'NO_EMBED', 'FAILED', 'ERROR') AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_batch_job_chunks bjc WHERE bjc.target = doc.target AND bjc.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND bjc.status = 'FAILED' ) < 3 ) OR COALESCE(e.content_hash, '') != COALESCE(c.content_hash, '') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query} != '' AND doc.title = #{query} THEN 0 WHEN #{query} != '' AND doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, doc.target, c.chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, doc.effective_status AS effectiveStatus, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, NULL AS pageNo, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.content_hash AS contentHash, AS parentSectionTitle, AS sectionType, c.embedding_text AS embeddingText, c.parent_key AS parentKey, c.chunk_version AS chunkVersion FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN law_api_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.activation_status = 'CANDIDATE' AND (#{target} = '' OR doc.target = #{target}) AND c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.chunk_version = #{chunkVersion} AND (e.chunk_id IS NULL OR e.status IN ('PENDING', 'NO_EMBED', 'FAILED', 'ERROR') OR COALESCE(e.content_hash, '') != COALESCE(c.content_hash, '')) ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.target AS target, doc.external_id AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.agency_name AS agencyName, doc.category_name AS categoryName, doc.source_date AS sourceDate, doc.effective_status AS effectiveStatus, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, NULL AS pageNo, c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.content_hash AS contentHash, AS parentSectionTitle, AS sectionType, NULL AS embeddingText, c.parent_key AS parentKey, c.chunk_version AS chunkVersion FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.activation_status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.sort_order BETWEEN #{sortOrder} - #{radius} AND #{sortOrder} + #{radius} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.chunk_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS currentIndexedCount, CONCAT( LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(SHA2(CONCAT(CAST(c.chunk_id AS CHAR), ':', c.content_hash), 256), 1, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0'), LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(SHA2(CONCAT(CAST(c.chunk_id AS CHAR), ':', c.content_hash), 256), 17, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0'), LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(SHA2(CONCAT(CAST(c.chunk_id AS CHAR), ':', c.content_hash), 256), 33, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0'), LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(SHA2(CONCAT(CAST(c.chunk_id AS CHAR), ':', c.content_hash), 256), 49, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0') ) AS contentFingerprint, COALESCE( DATE_FORMAT( MAX(GREATEST(doc.updated_at, c.updated_at, e.updated_at)), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f' ), '' ) AS updatedWatermark FROM law_api_chunk_embeddings e JOIN law_api_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} AND e.status = 'INDEXED' AND e.content_hash = c.content_hash AND c.content_hash REGEXP '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}$' AND c.activation_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, CASE WHEN doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active, c.content_hash AS chunkContentHash, e.content_hash AS embeddingContentHash, e.status AS embeddingStatus, e.vector_point_id AS vectorPointId FROM law_api_document_chunks c JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN law_api_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE (#{target} = '' OR doc.target = #{target}) ORDER BY c.chunk_id LIMIT LEAST(#{limit}, 10000)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_api_chunk_embeddings ( chunk_id, embedding_model, vector_store, vector_point_id, content_hash, status, embedded_at, last_error_message ) VALUES ( #{chunkId}, #{model}, #{vectorStore}, #{vectorPointId}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, NOW(), #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector_point_id = VALUES(vector_point_id), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), status = VALUES(status), embedded_at = VALUES(embedded_at), last_error_message = VALUES(last_error_message)
mapper.update: UPDATE law_api_document_chunks SET index_status = #{status}, indexed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'INDEXED' THEN NOW() ELSE indexed_at END, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE chunk_id = #{chunkId}

UPDATE law_api_chunk_embeddings e JOIN law_api_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id JOIN law_api_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id SET e.status = 'FAILED', e.last_error_message = 'Recovered stale BATCH_SUBMITTED without active batch job.', e.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} AND e.status = 'BATCH_SUBMITTED' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.embedded_at, NOW()) >= #{staleMinutes} AND (#{target} = '' OR doc.target = #{target}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM semantic_batch_job_chunks bjc JOIN semantic_batch_jobs bj ON bj.batch_job_id = bjc.batch_job_id WHERE bjc.chunk_id = e.chunk_id AND bj.target = doc.target AND bj.status IN ('validating', 'in_progress', 'finalizing') )
